events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released 55 years ago today in the US.

angles.name: Imagine 55th
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to imagine a world of peace. What track from the 'Imagine' album still resonates with you?

events.title: Sting Turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, known as Sting, the legendary musician and frontman of The Police, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting 75th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, what's your favourite track from the Geordie legend?

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod 25 years ago, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple introduced the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day 2026
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, marking 64 years since the premiere of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 64 years of 007. What's your top Bond film or favourite theme song?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese 87th Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, what's your favourite Cleese comedy moment?

events.title: The 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: White Album 58th
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58 years old today! A sprawling masterpiece that showcased their individual talents. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the irreplaceable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost a true showman. Remembering the incredible talent and legacy of Freddie Mercury today. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today, marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61st
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and set new standards. What's your go-to track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His spirit of peace and his timeless music live on. What's the song that reminds you most of him?

events.title: David Bowie Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary and ever-evolving artist David Bowie.

angles.name: Bowie 80th Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been his 80th birthday. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable. Which era of Bowie is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley Would Have Been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd Tribute
angles.copy: Long live the King! Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page Turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page 83rd Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and one of rock's most influential guitarists. What's his greatest riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart Turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart 82nd Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! A career spanning decades with that unmistakable voice. What's your favourite Rod the Mod hit?

events.title: Suggs Turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs 66th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the Nutty Boy himself, Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us joy for decades. What's your favourite Madness tune?
